title: Classroom Practice — Speaking: A Day at School
tier: Classroom practice; not an ACCESS tier
overview: Look at the pictures of a school day and a class garden project. For each task, plan your answer, then say it aloud in full sentences. Your teacher will listen.

sections.title: A Day at School
sections.directions: We will talk about your school day, compare two classes, explain a process, and give an opinion. Look at the pictures, plan your answer, and say it aloud. Use the word banks to help you.

items.title: Speaking Task 1
items.skill: Describing a picture using academic language
passage: Look at the picture of a busy school hallway. A model student, Mia, said: "I see students walking with backpacks and a row of lockers."
Now it is your turn. What other things do you see in the picture? Say your answer aloud.
items.adminScript: Look at the picture of the school hallway. What things do you see? Say your answer aloud in full sentences.
items.prompt: Look at the picture of the school hallway. What things do you see?
items.responseLabel: Planning notes (then say your answer aloud)
items.responsePlaceholder: I see ___ and ___. The ___ is next to the ___.
items.correct: Strong answer (model): I see students walking to class with their backpacks. There is a long row of lockers next to the wall, and a clock is above the door.
items.support: Use the word bank and full sentences. Say your answer out loud, then your teacher can listen.

picture.alt: A busy school hallway with a row of lockers, students carrying backpacks, a clock, and a water fountain.

items.title: Speaking Task 2
items.skill: Comparing two things using comparison words
passage: Two classes voted for a class pet. 📊 Class A chose a hamster, and Class B chose a fish.
Compare the two choices. How are they alike, and how are they different? Say your answer aloud.
items.adminScript: Two classes chose different class pets. Tell me one way the pets are alike and one way they are different. Use comparison words.
items.prompt: Compare a hamster and a fish as class pets. How are they alike and different?
items.responseLabel: Planning notes (then say your answer aloud)
items.responsePlaceholder: Both a hamster and a fish are ___. A hamster is ___, but a fish is ___.
items.correct: Strong answer (model): Both a hamster and a fish are class pets that students take care of. A hamster is furry and needs a cage, but a fish lives in water and needs a tank.
items.support: Use the word bank and full sentences. Say your answer out loud, then your teacher can listen.

items.title: Speaking Task 3
passage: The science class is growing a bean plant. 🌱☀️💧 They plant a seed, water it, give it sunlight, and watch it grow.
Explain how the class grows the bean plant, step by step. Say your answer aloud.
items.adminScript: Explain how the science class grows a bean plant. Tell the steps in order. Use order words like first, then, and finally.
items.prompt: Explain how the class grows a bean plant, step by step.
items.responseLabel: Planning notes (then say your answer aloud)
items.responsePlaceholder: First, the class ___. Then they ___. Finally, ___.
items.correct: Strong answer (model): First, the class plants a seed in the soil. Then they water it every day and give it sunlight because plants need water and light. Finally, the seed grows into a bean plant.
items.support: Use the word bank and full sentences. Say your answer out loud, then your teacher can listen.

items.title: Speaking Task 4
items.skill: Giving an opinion with a reason
passage: Your school may add 15 more minutes of recess or 15 more minutes of lunch. 🍎🏃
Which do you think is better? Give your opinion and a reason. Say your answer aloud.
items.adminScript: Your school can add more recess or more lunch time. Which do you think is better, and why? Give your opinion and at least one reason.
items.prompt: Should the school add more recess or more lunch time? Give your opinion and a reason.
items.responseLabel: Planning notes (then say your answer aloud)
items.responsePlaceholder: I think the school should add ___ because ___.
wordBank: I think the school should add
items.correct: Strong answer (model): I think the school should add more recess because students can play and get exercise. In addition, a short break helps us focus better in our afternoon classes.
items.support: Use the word bank and full sentences. Say your answer out loud, then your teacher can listen.
